notices.support: Where both apply (a financed sale signed at the home), the two notices say different things about the refund; this is a point for a lawyer, not something the text resolves.
notices.summary_row: "BUYER'S RIGHT TO CANCEL" statement (credit sales solicited at the home)
notices.hold_reason: Unresolved conflict: the Oklahoma statement says the seller may keep up to 5 percent of the cash price, but the federal rule gives a full refund, and the state file says the text does not settle which controls (a point for a lawyer). Also the block is the whole section 2-503 (including the seller's duties and a rule letting the buyer cancel until the seller complies), so printing it would put non-notice statute text in the contract, and the statute prints the misprint 'sevices'.

unsure: OK-cancel-credit: whether the 5 percent retention sentence may be printed on a financed home sale that also carries the federal notice is unresolved; the state file leaves it to a lawyer.

OK-cancel-credit: whether a contract with a deposit and progress payments counts as 'payable in installments' under 14A O.S. 2-104 is not settled by the text, so it is unclear when the state statement belongs in the contract at all.
OK: 15 O.S. 765.6 repair clause is optional and has no prescribed wording, so no notice was added for it.
